skill: Build a smooth camera pan animation in React

route.title: Make a box slide across the screen
route.summary: Use framer-motion to animate a colored box moving from left to right when you click a button. This teaches you the basics of motion in React.

challenge.prompt: Take a screenshot or screen recording showing a box that slides across the screen when you click a button. The box should move smoothly, not jump.

route.title: Freeze random stars in one spot
route.summary: Generate 50 random stars (circles) once when the page loads and store them in useState. They should never change position unless you refresh the page.

challenge.prompt: Take two screenshots a few seconds apart showing the same exact stars in the same exact positions. Write a sentence explaining why useState keeps them frozen.

route.title: Move all the stars down together
route.summary: Put all your stars inside a motion.div container. When you click a button, animate the entire container downward by 500 pixels over 2 seconds.

challenge.prompt: Record a short video or take before/after screenshots showing all the stars moving down smoothly as one group when you click the button.

route.title: Make text fly upward while stars go down
route.summary: Add a title like PEAK at the top. When you click the button, the stars move down and the title moves up at the same time. They should move in opposite directions.

challenge.prompt: Show a video or screenshots proving the title moves upward while the stars move downward, both starting at the exact same moment.

route.title: Use the same timing for smooth motion
route.summary: Set both animations to last exactly 2.5 seconds with easeInOut easing. This makes them feel connected, like a real camera move.

challenge.prompt: Paste the code where you set duration to 2.5 and ease to easeInOut for both the stars container and the title. Explain in one sentence why matching timing matters.

route.title: Make the title move faster than the stars
route.summary: Change the title so it moves upward by 800 pixels while the stars only move down by 500 pixels. This creates depth, like the title is closer to the camera.

challenge.prompt: Show a video where the title clearly moves faster and farther than the stars, creating a layered effect.

route.title: Bring in loading text from below
route.summary: Add text that says 'Generating your route...' positioned below the screen. When you click the button, animate it upward into the center while the other animations happen.

challenge.prompt: Record a video showing three things moving at once: stars down, title up, and loading text up from below. All should start together.

route.title: Add a mountain that appears at the bottom
route.summary: Draw or place a simple mountain shape at the bottom of the screen. As the stars move down, the mountain should become visible, like the camera is descending toward it.

challenge.prompt: Show before and after: before the animation the mountain is barely visible or hidden, after the animation it's clearly in view at the bottom.

route.title: Test that stars never regenerate
route.summary: Click the animation button 5 times in a row. The stars should stay in the exact same positions every single time, never flickering or changing.

challenge.prompt: Explain in 2-3 sentences how you know the stars are frozen. What part of your code prevents them from regenerating?

route.title: Make the input box fly away with the title
route.summary: Add a fake input box next to your title. Put both inside one motion.div wrapper so they fly upward together as a single unit.

challenge.prompt: Show a video where the title and input box move upward together, staying perfectly aligned the whole time.

route.title: Smooth out the entire camera pan
route.summary: Adjust all your animation distances and timings so the whole sequence feels like one smooth camera move. The stars should translate by exactly one full screen height (100vh).

challenge.prompt: Write a short description of what each element does during the animation: stars container, title/input wrapper, loading text, and mountain. Include the distance each one moves.

route.title: Build the full cinematic start screen
route.summary: Combine everything into one polished animation: frozen starfield, camera pan down, title/input flying up and away, loading text entering from below, mountain revealed at the bottom. Make it feel like a real app.

challenge.prompt: Record a full video of the entire animation from start to finish. It should look smooth, cinematic, and professional. No flickers, no jumps, just one beautiful camera move.
